title: Crash before commit: the new owner re-reads, so records are processed twice
caption: c2 processes b0 and b1 from p1, dies before committing, and c1 takes over p1 from the last committed offset, 0.

messages.label: poll from offset 0
messages.note: c2 owns p1. Its committed offset is 0.

messages.label: process b0, b1
messages.note: The side effects (emails, DB writes) happen here.

messages.label: crash before commit
messages.note: The commit of offset 2 never happens, and c2's heartbeats stop.

messages.label: rebalance: you now own p1
messages.note: No heartbeat within the session timeout (about 10–45 s), so the coordinator reassigns c2's partitions. Consumption of p1 pauses meanwhile.

messages.label: poll from committed offset 0
messages.note: The only progress the group knows about is the committed offset.

messages.label: b0, b1 (again)
messages.note: b0 and b1 are processed a second time. That's at-least-once: the handler must be idempotent.
